rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and home interior (smoke damage) is clearly property damage. The loss is to the insured's own property, not third-party liability or auto-related.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire (grease flare-up from stovetop) with charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling/walls. No injuries; damage contained to kitchen. Quickly extinguished by policyholder. Policy POL-1001 is active with $500 deductible and $250k limit.

case_facts.damage_description: charred kitchen cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls

rationale: Straightforward wind damage to the policyholder's own roof shingles. No third-party liability, no theft, no vehicle involvement. Clear property damage covered under homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Wind damage to four roof shingles on back porch overhang; estimated repair cost $400 (below $2,500 deductible); no interior damage. Low severity, routine routing.

case_facts.damage_type: four shingles blown off roof overhang
